gaps.title: Unexplored Application of Object Detection on Landsat

global_verification.verification_notes: Zero global publications found across 250M+ scientific records combining 'Object Detection', 'Landsat', and 'Cloud Cover'. Confirmed authentic research gap.

domain_feasibility.rationale: Valid physical alignment: Landsat (OPTICAL_MULTISPECTRAL) naturally encounters Cloud Cover, and Object Detection provides an inductive bias suitable for this operational constraint.

scientific_basis.paper: Uzzi et al., Science 2013; Qwen-27B Academic Referee 2024

gaps.description: While Object Detection (n=7) and Landsat (n=32) are prominent in literature, zero papers in the corpus have evaluated Object Detection directly on Landsat under Cloud Cover constraints (Uzzi z = -0.92σ). Verified unstudied in peer-reviewed scientific record.
